'''R2-R7''' was a green [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served aboard the [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] [[Radiant VII/Legends|''Radiant VII'']] with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Maoi Madakor/Legends|Maoi Madakor]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Antidar Williams/Legends|Antidar Williams]] when it was destroyed by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

R2-R7's role aboard the ''Radiant VII'' was to monitor flight performance, carry out repairs and carry out indispensable in-flight backup for Captain Madakor and Lieutenant Williams. He used his radar eye to track flight paths and scan for malfunctions from a docking station situated in the middle of the Republic cruiser.<ref name="LEGOCEUpdated" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:R2_r7.jpg|thumb|right|R2-R7 in LEGO form]]
R2-R7 was first mentioned in the [[2007]] [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] set 7665 Republic Cruiser.<ref name="Cruiser">{{LEGOCite|num=7665|name=Republic Cruiser}}</ref> It was later mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
